about: Scout's tour of Sightline: the one file that holds its steps. The page (src/sightline/Tour.tsx) reads it to drive the real screen, How it works and the README list the same steps, scripts/tour-voice.mjs renders each step's words once in Scout's voice, and the tutorial video's recorder reads it too, so the tour and the video say the same thing.
name: The one-minute tour

voice.from: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, the voice Scout speaks with on the site (en-US-Chirp3-HD-Leda), rendered once from each step's "say"

video.about: The walkthrough video. The Guide shows its player only once the file answers as a video. Its chapters are read from the chapters file (WebVTT, one cue a chapter) or, if that is not there, from the list of steps the recorder writes beside the video.

demo.about: The 30-second demo. Shown in the Guide only once the file answers as a video.

scenario.about: The landing the tour plans from step 3 on: one that does not fit the default mission, so the verdict has a reason and a next landing to show.

steps.title: The Moon, now
steps.say: A lander needs the Sun for power and Earth for radio. This is the Moon from above its south pole, lit as it is now: press play.

steps.title: The markers
steps.say: Each marker is a landing site. Its shape and color say what it can see at this moment: the Sun, Earth, both or neither.

steps.title: Plan a landing
steps.say: Choose where to land, when, and which mission. Everything below answers for that plan.

steps.title: The verdict
steps.say: Sightline says whether the landing fits the mission, and why. If it does not, it offers the next landing that does.

steps.title: What the lander sees
steps.say: This is the real skyline around the site, with the Sun and Earth where they stand at that hour. A body below the skyline is out of view.

steps.title: The month ahead
steps.say: The bands show the weeks after landing: green is the Sun and Earth both in view. Move along them, then press "land here" to try that hour.

steps.title: More than one plan
steps.say: Press the plus to add another site or date, up to four. Compare sets them side by side, and the Planner gives them the whole window.

steps.title: Ask Scout
steps.say: Ask Scout in plain words: he looks the answer up in the same data. Home takes you back to the Moon.
